challenges.name: scholarship-ranking
challenges.title: Rank the cohort for the merit scholarship
challenges.description: Write the three functions behind the Riverside Polytechnic scholarship ranking. average_of returns the exact mean of a student's scores (no truncation: 9.5 9.5 9.5 8.5 is 9.25). rank_students sorts the cohort in place: higher average first, and equal averages by smaller student id, whatever order the input file has. count_at_least returns how many students have an average greater than or equal to a threshold. The test runner reads K and one line per student (id|full name|scores separated by spaces), fills in each average with your average_of, ranks the cohort, prints the first K places as "<rank>. <id> <name> <average with 2 decimals>" and then "at least 8.00: <count> of <cohort size>".
